rows.question: Document authority
rows.required_or_permitted: Both Primers are non-normative; both Part1 editions declare normative status.
rows.boundary: Local non-normative content remains distinct within a normative document.

rows.question: Target partition
rows.required_or_permitted: All required facts/relationships must be mapped for each unique target value; selected section3.2 text is unchanged.
rows.boundary: Different inputs/files and different targets are different partitions; no global merging rule follows.

rows.question: Optional item de-duplication
rows.required_or_permitted: Primer permits discretion. Per-input existential mapping does not itself demand pairwise distinct output nodes.
rows.boundary: One output can serve multiple inputs only if it satisfies every applicable mapping obligation; no sufficient algorithm or processor result established.

rows.question: Numeric output values
rows.required_or_permitted: Non-nil numeric mapping applies the declared format transformation, scale and sign; the Primer says differing values must both appear.
rows.boundary: Displayed lexical strings alone are not the mapped values. Nil exempts child-content rule; no registry transform executed.

rows.question: Accuracy reduction during transformation
rows.required_or_permitted: Exact declared decimals/precision attributes and their prescribed absence must be preserved, not replaced with a highest-accuracy representative.
rows.boundary: This is transformation mapping, separate from a subsequent analytical de-duplication policy.

rows.question: IDs/custom-attribute collapse
rows.required_or_permitted: An output cannot have id=a and id=b for unequal non-absent input IDs. Nor can a single mapped attribute with one expanded name have two unequal required values.
rows.boundary: No claim that every custom-attribute difference prevents merging: different names or absent constraints may be compatible; no sufficiency proof.

rows.question: Non-numeric and nil mapping
rows.required_or_permitted: Section11.2 requires the input concept/context/ID/other attributes and transformed content; its child-content obligation excludes nil facts.
rows.boundary: No DTS/datatype, schema or transformation validation was executed; value-space equality is not assumed to settle every mapping condition.

rows.question: Language inheritance
rows.required_or_permitted: Both Primers mention ancestor language propagation; the corrected Part1 adds a nonNormativeNote distinguishing explicit item language and target-root language from arbitrary Inline ancestor inheritance.
rows.boundary: Addition is not independently dated by AppendixE and is not a new normative MUST. No installed behavior or global errata claim.

rows.question: Tuple duplicates
rows.required_or_permitted: Tuple content has unique order, must satisfy same-order whitespace-normalized equality, and is emitted in order; duplicate-child reduction is described as necessary.
rows.boundary: Literal equality includes attributes. Preserve the exact set/validation wording; no independent schema or algorithm conformance established.

rows.question: Relationship mapping
rows.required_or_permitted: Corrected13.2 requires the two mapped facts to satisfy the rules for F and N respectively; original says f and F. Required relationships remain part of target obligations.
rows.boundary: The 2013 expression is retained as written. No footnote-subtree/schema conformance, deletion or rewriting permission inferred.

rows.question: 2018 complete-duplicate shorthand
rows.required_or_permitted: Note complete equality ignores custom attributes/footnotes; it cannot be used as a sufficient input/output collapsing predicate for the inspected mapping rules.
rows.boundary: The note remains guidance. Its formula/calculation recommendations are separate inquiries.

rows.question: Edition and history comparison
rows.required_or_permitted: Retained index exposes July2026 corrected sources. Primer revision entry17Nov2015 differs from publication index9Dec2015; validation and registry text visibly changed.
rows.boundary: Revision/publication dates need not match. No latest-worldwide or exhaustive correction-coverage inference.

rows.question: Processor/suite conformance
rows.required_or_permitted: DTS access is optional; source inspection establishes text obligations only.
rows.boundary: Part2 schema, acquired code, conformance pairs and installed behavior were not executed or admitted.

rows.question: Occurrence/provenance retention
rows.required_or_permitted: Target-document mapping can omit some duplicate occurrences while still differing from archival source-preservation needs.
rows.boundary: Retain raw IXDS, occurrence links and unresolved conflicts; no issuer, policy, vintage, manuscript or whole-row promotion.
